mapper.select: select CR.* , CI.status , round(CI.PORT_IN_SPEED / 1000, 2) as portReceiveNum , round(CI.PORT_OUT_SPEED / 1000, 2) as portSendNum , to_number(CR.port_index_rank) as num from COLLECT_ROUTE CR, (SELECT * FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(COLLECT_CODE) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId})) CI where CR.Asset_id = CI.asset_id and CR.port_index_name = CI.port_index and CR.asset_id = #{assetId} order by num asc

select i.asset_id assetId, i.port_in portIn, i.port_out portOut, i.port_index portIndex, i.status portStatus, i.port_index_rank portIndexRank, '2' as maOrAt, r.port_ip portIp, r.at_asset_id atAssetId, r.at_port_index_name atPortIndexName, r.at_name atName, r.at_net_address atNetAddress, r.at_phys_address atPhysAddress from collect_interfaces i left join collect_route r on i.asset_id = r.asset_id and i.port_index = r.port_index_name where i.port_type in (6, 18, 22, 23, 39, 56, 135) and i.port_index not like 'unrouted%'
and i.collect_code = (select MAX(collect_code) from collect_interfaces where asset_id = #{assetId})
and i.collect_code in (select MAX(collect_code) from collect_interfaces group by asset_id)
order by i.asset_id, i.port_index_rank
